    import scipy.stats as st    #加载统计包
def mcor_test(X):     #相关系数矩阵检验
    p=X.shape[1];p
    sp=np.ones([p, p]).astype(str)
    for i in range(0,p):
        for j in range(i,p):        
            P=st.pearsonr(X.iloc[:,i],X.iloc[:,j])[1]        
            if P>0.05: sp[i,j]=' '
            if(P>0.01 and P<=0.05): sp[i,j]='*'
            if(P>0.001 and P<=0.01): sp[i,j]='**'
            if(P<=0.001): sp[i,j]='***'
            r=st.pearsonr(X.iloc[:,i],X.iloc[:,j])[0]
            sp[j,i]=round(r,4)
            if(i==j):sp[i,j]='------'    
    print(pd.DataFrame(sp,index=X.columns,columns=X.columns))
    print("\n下三角为相关系数，上三角为检验p值 * p<0.05 ** p<0.05 *** p<0.001")
    import scipy.stats as st #加载统计包 def mcor_test(X): #相关系数矩阵检验 p=X.shape[1];p sp=np.ones([p, p]).astype(str) for i in range(0,p): for j in range(i,p): P=st.pearsonr(X.iloc[:,i],X.iloc[:,j])[1] if P>0.05: sp[i,j]=' ' if(P>0.01 and P<=0.05): sp[i,j]='*' if(P>0.001 and P<=0.01): sp[i,j]='**' if(P<=0.001): sp[i,j]='***' r=st.pearsonr(X.iloc[:,i],X.iloc[:,j])[0] sp[j,i]=round(r,4) if(i==j):sp[i,j]='------' print(pd.DataFrame(sp,index=X.columns,columns=X.columns)) print("\n下三角为相关系数，上三角为检验p值 * p<0.05 ** p<0.05 *** p<0.001")
